$comment: 语法大厅 G38（V0.9 P3 进阶层）。比喻锚点：力度记号的高级用法：弱奏里的言外之意。承接 G17（情态动词一）：同一批词的第二层意思——推测三档 must/may·might/can't 与委婉请求 Could/Would/May/Shall、mind doing。只讲初中层面，不碰 must have done 类完成推测。全部内容原创。
title: 情态动词二（推测与委婉）
metaphor: 力度记号的高级用法：弱奏里的言外之意
ketNote: 老实说：KET 只考 can/must 的基本义（八课 L2 已覆盖），推测和委婉的第二层是初中和 PET 的内容——这课为它打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 同一批力度记号的第二层意思：must一定是，can't不可能，could更客气。
sections.why: 中文表推测靠副词：「肯定」「大概」「不可能」。英语更省——让情态动词打第二份工：must be 一定是、may be 可能是、can't be 不可能是，词没换，意思多了一层。委婉也是同一批词在加班：Could you...? 里的 could 不是过去式，而是把 can 往后退半步——时间上退一步，心理距离就远一步，命令就变成了商量。这里有个中式英语高发坑：「不可能」要用 can't，不能用 mustn't——mustn't 是门上贴的「禁止」，跟推测无关。KET 只考 can/must 的基本义；第二层是初中和 PET 的戏。
sections.metaphorStory: 夜里排练散场，团里的灯还亮着。学徒看了眼门口那双旧皮鞋：「It must be the conductor——全团只有指挥穿这双。」师傅点头：「你刚用了力度记号的第二层：f 不再是『响』，是『把握十足』。要是没那双鞋呢？」「It may be the cleaner——五五开。」「要是团长呢？」「It can't be him——他在外地演出。」师傅补了一句：「说『不可能』千万别用 mustn't——那是门上贴的『禁止入内』，管规矩不管猜测。」第二天学徒想借节拍器，张口就是 Give me your metronome，师傅假装没听见。学徒改口：Could you lend me your metronome? 师傅立刻递过来：「同一个请求，退半步说——弱奏比强奏传得更远。」

cards.detail: must be（约九成把握，一定是）· may / might be（五五开，可能是；might 把握更小）· can't be（不可能是）。
cards.example: She must be tired. / It may be Amy's. / That can't be Tom.

cards.detail: mustn't 是「禁止」（不许做），不参与推测——推测的否定档只有 can't。
cards.example: That can't be true.（✗ mustn't be true）

cards.rule: 委婉请求：退半步的过去形式
cards.detail: Could you / Would you / May I 开头——could、would 不表过去，表「退一步」的客气。
cards.example: Could you pass me the salt? / May I come in?

cards.detail: Would you like + 名词 / to do（要不要…）；Would you mind + doing（介意…吗，mind 只收 G31 的打包件）。
cards.example: Would you like some tea? / Would you mind closing the window?

cards.detail: Shall I ...?（我来…好吗）· Shall we ...?（我们…好吗）。
cards.example: Shall we meet at the school gate at eight?

cards.detail: Would you mind...? 问的是「介不介意」——想答应说 Not at all / Of course not；说 Yes 等于拒绝。
cards.example: — Would you mind waiting? — Not at all.

basic.en: The light is on — someone must be in the room.
It may rain later. Take an umbrella.
basic.cn: 待会儿可能下雨，带把伞。

basic.en: That can't be Tom. He is in Beijing now.
basic.cn: 那不可能是汤姆，他现在在北京。

basic.en: Could you pass me the salt, please?
basic.cn: 能把盐递给我吗？（退半步的客气）

mid.en: She must be tired after the long trip.
mid.cn: 长途旅行之后她一定累了。

mid.en: — Whose scarf is this? — It might be Amy's.
mid.cn: ——这是谁的围巾？——可能是艾米的吧。（把握不大）

mid.en: Would you mind closing the window?
mid.cn: 你介意把窗关上吗？（mind + doing）

mid.en: Shall we meet at the school gate at eight?
mid.cn: 我们八点在校门口见好吗？

trap.en: The phone is ringing — it must be Mum.
trap.note: must be 是「一定是」的推测——不是「必须」。

trap.en: That can't be our teacher — he never wears a hat.
trap.cn: 那不可能是我们老师——他从不戴帽子。
trap.note: 推测的「不可能」用 can't；mustn't 是禁止。

trap.en: Could you help me carry the drum?
trap.note: could 不表过去——是把 can 往后退半步的客气。

trap.en: — Would you mind turning down the music? — Not at all.
trap.cn: ——介意把音乐调小吗？——一点也不（马上调）。
trap.note: mind 接 doing；想答应要说 Not at all。

trap.en: — Someone is knocking. — It might be the postman.
trap.note: might 是把握最小的一档——五五开还往下。
推测用法最常见的口语——不是「你必须开玩笑」。

redBlack.bad: You mustn't be tired — we just started.（想说：你不可能累）
redBlack.good: You can't be tired — we just started.
redBlack.why: mustn't 是「不许」——这句成了命令对方「不准累」，听的人一头雾水。

redBlack.bad: — Would you mind waiting a moment? — Yes!（想答应等一下）
redBlack.good: — Not at all. / Of course not.
redBlack.why: mind 问「介不介意」——答 Yes 等于「我介意，不等」，嘴上拒绝了还以为自己答应了。

redBlack.bad: He must tired after the game.
redBlack.good: He must be tired after the game.
redBlack.why: 情态后接原形——be 不能丢（G17 的老规矩在第二层照样生效）。
推测的否定档只有 can't——mustn't 管的是禁止。

redBlack.bad: Could I to borrow your pen?
redBlack.why: 情态后直接原形——to 不进门。

redBlack.bad: Would you mind to open the window?
redBlack.good: Would you mind opening the window?
redBlack.why: mind 只收打包件 doing（G31 的门规）。

redBlack.bad: Would you like go with us?
redBlack.good: Would you like to go with us?
redBlack.why: would like 接 to do——别跟 mind 的门规弄混。

redBlack.bad: May you help me with this box?
redBlack.good: Could you help me with this box?
redBlack.why: 请对方做事用 Could / Would you；May I 是请求自己获准。
may 直接接动词原形 rain——be 和动词别叠罗汉。
情态后原形——三单 -s 不进门。

redBlack.bad: It may be Amy's.（有人说 might 是过去式，不能说现在）
redBlack.good: may / might 说现在的推测都行。
redBlack.why: might 只是把握更小一点——不挡意思不设坑。

redBlack.bad: Can you help me?（有人说不礼貌，必须 could）
redBlack.good: can / could 都行，could 更客气。
redBlack.why: 熟人之间 can 完全自然——不挡意思。

contrast.cn: 他肯定在家。（靠副词「肯定」）
contrast.diff: 中文加副词；英语让 must 打第二份工。

contrast.cn: 不可能是他！（一个「不可能」）
contrast.en: It can't be him.（不用 mustn't）
contrast.diff: 英语把「禁止」（mustn't）和「不可能」（can't）分了家；中文不分。

contrast.cn: 把盐递给我。（加个「请」就客气了）
contrast.en: Could you pass me the salt?
contrast.diff: 中文靠「请」字；英语靠把情态动词往后退半步。

contrast.cn: 你介意关窗吗？——不介意（=答应）
contrast.en: Would you mind closing...? — Not at all.
contrast.diff: 两边逻辑一致，但英语想答应千万别说 Yes——Yes 是「我介意」。

contrast.cn: 我们八点见，好吗？（「好吗」在句尾）
contrast.diff: 中文句尾商量；英语句首 Shall 开场。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 推测三档 must/may/can't；请求退半步 could/would；mind 接 doing 答 Not at all。
steps: 先分场合：在猜测事实，还是在请求/提议？
猜测按把握选档：九成 must be，五五 may/might be，不可能 can't be。
「不可能」永远 can't——mustn't 是门上的「禁止」。
请求要客气：Could you / Would you 开头——过去形式表退一步，不表过去。
Would you like + to do；Would you mind + doing；提议用 Shall I / we。
答 mind 的问题：想答应 = Not at all / Of course not。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩侦探推理：我摆线索你下判断。『书包在门口』——哥哥回来了吗？你按把握回答：很确定就 He must be home，拿不准就 He may be home，绝无可能就 He can't be home。我不懂英语没关系，我记三个音就行：must、may、can't——你举的证据够不够硬，得配得上你选的档。」再玩借东西：你直接说『给我』我就装没听见，你退半步说 Could you...，我才递过去——让孩子亲身体会弱奏的力量。最后一关：我问 Would you mind...?，你想答应的话，答的必须是 Not at all。
questions: 「一定是妈妈打来的」和「妈妈必须打电话」，must 的两层意思差在哪？
「不可能是他」为什么不能用 mustn't？mustn't 留给什么场合？
Could you help me? 里的 could 是过去式吗？它客气在哪儿？

sections.echo: could、would、might 表客气不表过去，看似不讲理，其实是人类语言共通的规律——距离产生礼貌：时间上退一步，心理距离就远一步，命令就软成了商量；中文「您看能不能…」绕远说话，是同一个道理。而这批词正是 G17 那批最常用的力度记号——用得越多，攒下的言外之意越厚：must 从「必须」长出「一定是」，can 从「能」长出「可能」，will 从「意愿」磨成了「将来」。越常用的词越多义，每一层新意思都是千万次使用磨出来的包浆——「越常用越不讲理」的又一副面孔。

memoryCard.alt: G38 记忆卡：情态动词第二层——推测三档 must be/may·might be/can't be（不可能绝不用 mustn't）；委婉包 Could/Would you、May I、Shall I/we、would like to do、mind doing；答 mind 想答应说 Not at all；警示 mustn't be true、must tired、mind to open、may be rain 四类错误。

stages.name: 认一认 · 第二层记号

questions.q: The light is on — someone must be in. 这里 must 表示？
questions.explain: 力度记号的第二层——把握十足的推测。

questions.q: It may rain later. 这里 may 表示？
questions.explain: may 的第二层——可能。

questions.q: That can't be Tom. 这里 can't 表示？
questions.explain: 推测的否定档——不可能。

questions.q: 推测「不可能」用哪个词？
questions.explain: 只有 can't——mustn't 是禁止。

questions.q: mustn't 的意思是？
questions.explain: 门上贴的「禁止」——跟推测无关。

questions.q: 推测把握最大的一档是？
questions.explain: must be——约九成把握。

questions.q: might 和 may 相比，把握？
questions.explain: might 是五五开再往下。

questions.q: Could you help me? 里的 could 表示？
questions.explain: 退半步的礼貌——不表过去。

questions.q: 为什么 Could 比 Can 客气？
options: 退半步产生距离感，压力更小
因为 could 是书面语
因为 could 音节更多
questions.explain: 时间退一步，心理距离远一步。

questions.q: 「要不要来点茶」怎么说？
questions.explain: 客气的邀请——Would you like。

questions.q: Would you mind ___ the window?（关窗）
questions.explain: mind 只收打包件 doing。

questions.q: 「我们八点见好吗？」用哪个开头？
questions.explain: 提议——Shall we。

questions.q: 回答 Would you mind...? 想表示「答应」，说？
questions.explain: 不介意=答应——Not at all。

questions.q: May I borrow your pen? 是在？
questions.explain: May I = 我可以…吗。

questions.q: 情态动词后面接动词的什么形式？
questions.explain: 第二层照样守 G17 的老规矩——原形。

questions.q: You must be joking! 的意思是？
questions.explain: 最常见的推测口语。

stages.name: 选一选 · 按把握选档

questions.q: Her light is still on. She ___ still be studying.
questions.explain: 灯还亮着——九成把握 must。

questions.q: — Whose umbrella is this? — It ___ be Amy's; she has one like this.
questions.explain: 有点像但不确定——may。

questions.q: That ___ be our bus — ours is No. 12, not No. 2.
questions.explain: 号码对不上——不可能 can't。

questions.q: You've practised all day. You ___ be tired.
questions.explain: 练了一整天——一定累了。

questions.q: ___ you pass me the dictionary, please?
questions.explain: 客气的请求——Could you。

questions.q: ___ I open the window? It's hot in here.
questions.explain: 我来开窗好吗——Shall I。

questions.q: Would you like ___ to the concert with us?
questions.explain: would like + to do。

questions.q: Would you mind ___ more quietly?
questions.explain: mind + doing。

questions.q: — Would you mind waiting outside? — ___. I'll wait.
questions.explain: 答应=不介意——Not at all。

questions.q: He ___ be at home — I just saw him in the library.
questions.explain: 刚在图书馆见到他——不可能在家。

questions.q: — Someone is playing the piano. — It ___ be Miss Chen; only she has the key.
questions.explain: 只有她有钥匙——一定是她。

questions.q: ___ I come in, Mr Wang?
questions.explain: 请求获准进门——May I。

questions.q: It ___ snow tonight — the clouds are heavy, but who knows.
questions.explain: 拿不准——把握最小的 might。

questions.q: You ___ shout in the library.（图书馆规定）
questions.explain: 这是禁止不是推测——mustn't + 原形。

questions.q: — Could I use your phone? — ___
questions.explain: 答应就说 Sure / Of course——不说 you could。

questions.q: She ___ know the answer — she wrote the book!
questions.explain: 书都是她写的——一定知道。

questions.q: 哪一句推测对了？（他不可能是新来的鼓手）
options: He can't be the new drummer.
He mustn't be the new drummer.
He may not can be the new drummer.
questions.explain: 「不可能」只有 can't 这一档。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（你一定累了——歇会儿吧）
options: You must be tired — have a rest.
You must tired — have a rest.
You mustn't be tired — have a rest.
questions.explain: must + be——原形不能丢。

questions.q: 哪一句最客气？（能把琴谱递给我吗）
options: Could you pass me the music sheets?
Could you to pass me the music sheets?
Could you passing me the music sheets?
questions.explain: 情态后直接原形。

questions.q: 哪一句门规对了？（你介意把音乐关小点吗）
options: Would you mind turning down the music?
Would you mind to turn down the music?
Would you mind turn down the music?
questions.explain: mind 只收 doing。

questions.q: 哪一句搭配对了？（要不要跟我们一起去）
options: Would you like to come with us?
Would you like come with us?
Would you like coming with us?
questions.explain: would like + to do。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（明天可能下雨）
questions.explain: may 直接接原形 rain。

questions.q: 哪一句推测对了？（那不可能是真的）
questions.explain: can't + be——档位和原形都要对。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（我可以坐这儿吗）
questions.explain: May I + 原形。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（他可能来晚——不确定）
questions.explain: might + 原形——-s 和 to 都不进门。

questions.q: 哪一句提议对了？（我们现在出发好吗）
questions.explain: 提议用 Shall we + 原形。

questions.q: 哪一句推测对了？（她一定在家——窗户开着）
options: She must be at home — the window is open.
She must is at home — the window is open.
She mustn't be at home — the window is open.
questions.explain: must be——is 不能顶替 be。

questions.q: 哪一句请求对了？（帮我拿一下鼓好吗）
options: Would you help me carry the drum?
May you help me carry the drum?
Would you helping me carry the drum?
questions.explain: 请对方做事用 Would / Could you；May 不这么用。

questions.q: 哪一句推测对了？（这不可能是艾米的书包——她今天没来）
options: This can't be Amy's schoolbag — she isn't here today.
This mustn't be Amy's schoolbag — she isn't here today.
This can be not Amy's schoolbag — she isn't here today.
questions.explain: can't be——否定连在情态上。

questions.q: 哪个回答表示答应？（——你介意等等吗？）
options: Not at all. Take your time.
Yes, I do. Take your time.
questions.explain: 不介意=答应；Yes 反而是拒绝。

questions.q: 哪一句推测对了？（这肯定是妈妈打来的）
options: It must be Mum — she calls at this time every day.
It must Mum — she calls at this time every day.
It can't be Mum — she calls at this time every day.
questions.explain: must be + 证据——每天这个点来电话。

questions.q: 哪一句禁止说对了？（这儿不许停车——有标志）
options: You mustn't park here — look at the sign.
You can't be park here — look at the sign.
You mustn't be park here — look at the sign.
questions.explain: 禁止用 mustn't + 原形——这回轮到 mustn't 上场了。

questions.q: 两空：— Someone left a violin here. — It ___ be Lily's; she ___ be looking for it now.
questions.explain: 两处都是有把握的推测——must。

questions.q: 大考：— Is that Mr Li on the stage? — It ___ be him; he ___ flying to Shanghai right now.
questions.explain: 人在飞机上——不可能在台上。

questions.q: — The hall is full of laughter. — The show ___ be very funny.
questions.explain: 满场笑声——一定很好笑。

questions.q: 两空：___ you mind ___ me your notes? Mine are a mess.
questions.explain: Would you mind + doing。

questions.q: — It ___ be the wind — the door opened by itself. — Maybe, or it ___ be the cat.
questions.explain: 两个人都在低把握档猜——might / could。

questions.q: 选最客气的一句（向陌生人问路）：
options: Could you tell me the way to the station?
Tell me the way to the station.
You must tell me the way to the station.
questions.explain: 退半步的 Could you——命令句对陌生人太冲。

questions.q: — Shall I carry the box for you? — ___
questions.explain: 接受提议——Thanks, that would be great。

questions.q: 两空：You ___ be hungry — you've eaten three bowls! You ___ be joking when you say you want more.
questions.explain: 吃了三碗不可能饿；说还要一定是开玩笑。

questions.q: — May I take photos here? — Sorry, you ___. It's not allowed.
questions.explain: 规定禁止——mustn't。

questions.q: The song sounds familiar. It ___ be the one Grandpa often hums, but I'm not sure.
questions.explain: 拿不准——might。

questions.q: 两空：___ we practise once more? The show ___ begin in an hour.
questions.explain: 提议 Shall we；一小时后开演 will。

questions.q: — Would you like some more soup? — ___
questions.explain: like 的问题答 Yes, please / No, thanks——Not at all 是留给 mind 的。

questions.q: 找错：哪句的「不可能」说错了？
options: He mustn't be the winner — he didn't even join.
He can't be the winner — he didn't even join.
questions.explain: 推测的否定档没有 mustn't。

questions.q: 两空：___ I turn on the light? It ___ be dark soon.
questions.explain: 我来开灯好吗 Shall I；天快黑了 will。

questions.q: 找错：哪句答话答反了？
options: — Would you mind moving your bag? — Yes. Here you go.
— Would you mind moving your bag? — Not at all. Here you go.
questions.explain: 答 Yes = 我介意——嘴上拒绝手上照做，前后矛盾。

questions.q: 大考二：— The keys ___ be in my coat... — They ___ be; your coat is still in the car. ___ I go and check?
questions.explain: 一定在大衣里（must）；不可能——大衣在车上（can't）；我去看看好吗（Shall I）。

detective.sentence: That mustn't be our new teacher — he looks too young.
detective.fixed: That can't be our new teacher — he looks too young.
detective.clue: 推测「不可能」用 can't——mustn't 是门上的「禁止」。

detective.sentence: You must tired after such a long walk.
detective.fixed: You must be tired after such a long walk.
detective.clue: 情态后接原形——be 不能丢。

detective.sentence: Would you mind to wait a few minutes?
detective.fixed: Would you mind waiting a few minutes?
detective.clue: mind 只收打包件 doing（G31 的门规）。

detective.sentence: Could you to lend me your bike?
detective.fixed: Could you lend me your bike?
detective.clue: 情态后直接原形——to 不进门。

detective.sentence: It may be snow tonight, so wear warm clothes.
detective.fixed: It may snow tonight, so wear warm clothes.
detective.clue: may 直接接动词原形 snow——be 别乱入。

detective.sentence: He might knows the answer — ask him.
detective.fixed: He might know the answer — ask him.
detective.clue: 情态后原形——三单 -s 不进门。

detective.sentence: — Would you like some water? — Not at all.
detective.fixed: — Would you like some water? — Yes, please.
detective.clue: Not at all 是答 mind 的——like 的问题要答 Yes, please / No, thanks。
